title: Add docstrings to all modules and functions
body: Add module-level and function-level docstrings following PEP 257 conventions to all Python files. (Note: validation.py docstring is misplaced and get_scores is missing one).

title: Add input validation and type hints
body: Add type hints to all function signatures (e.g. def get_weather() -> dict) and input validation using pydantic or manual checks.

title: Add unit tests
body: Create a tests/ directory and add pytest-based unit tests for each module.

title: Add code formatting and linting tools
body: Set up black, ruff, and mypy with configuration files (pyproject.toml) and add them to CI.
